description:
[read-only] Lists the brands this connection can file content into and publish through. Use an `id` as `brandId` on create_content, publish, queues and analytics tools; "personal" means the account owner's personal accounts. A connection bound to one brand sees only that brand (and personal is null). Each brand has its `website` and a `setup` checklist (hasBrandKey, hasWebsite, hasCtaGoal, adsConnected): set a missing website with brand_profile_update; a brand API key is created by the owner in Settings, never by an agent.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brands.)

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

name: list_brands
title: List brands
